resources.string: AdımSayar reads your steps from the phone\'s own sensor. Android asks for the physical activity permission for this.
Permission denied. Settings → Apps → AdımSayar → Permissions → Physical activity → Allow.
This phone does not report a step counter sensor. AdımSayar cannot count steps on this device.
The phone detects steps but the counter is not moving. The sensor was reconnected; this warning goes away by itself after a few steps.
Can\'t read the HyperOS step record
Steps are not updating right now. A HyperOS update may have changed the record. You can turn off the switch below and keep counting with "Keep counting in the background".
The HyperOS step record is not moving

The phone\'s sensor has seen steps in the last few minutes but the HyperOS record is not increasing. Check again in a few minutes; if it doesn\'t recover, turn off the switch below and turn on "Keep counting in the background".
Steps are read from the phone\'s own step record. They are counted fully even while the app is closed, no notification is needed, and past days are added too.
Turn this on if steps aren\'t counted while the app is closed. The counter is kept on; a silent, persistent notification appears in the notification bar.

resources.string: Steps taken today and goal progress
Step counts for the last 7 days
Record steps in the background too
This phone may close apps in the background. The steps below let AdımSayar read the counter even while the app is closed.
This screen couldn\'t be opened on this phone. Do the step manually in Settings.
Settings → Apps → AdımSayar → Battery → No restrictions
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → AdımSayar → Autostart → On
On the same screen, Battery saver → No restrictions
Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add AdımSayar
Battery → App launch → AdımSayar → turn off Manage automatically, turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background
Battery → Allow background activity → AdımSayar: Allow background running
Battery → Background power consumption management → High background power consumption → whitelist AdımSayar
Auto management → select AdımSayar in the app list, turn on all three permissions
